name: iamscope
description: IAMScope - a local-first, multi-tenant IAM policy workbench with Impact, Graph, and Timeline lenses over one MongoDB data model.

scripts.build:packages: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/schemas/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/tokens/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && node ../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node ../node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/schemas/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/tokens/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json --noEmit && cd frontend && node ../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/schemas/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/tokens/tsconfig.json && cd backend && node ../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run && cd ../frontend && node ../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
